style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Wreath with Velvet Bow
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of timeless romance to your décor with this gorgeous 50cm artificial dusky rose wreath, beautifully arranged with soft-toned artificial roses in muted pinks and blush hues. Finished with a luxurious pink velvet bow, this wreath brings effortless charm and feminine elegance to any space. Whether gracing your front door, styled above a mantel, or featured as a statement centrepiece, this floral wreath offers all the beauty of fresh blooms. Perfect for weddings, spring styling, or year-round floral flair. Elevate your space with a wreath that whispers elegance and blooms with lasting beauty. . Wreath width: D50cm. . Matching garland available. . Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
